title: Enforce free-only and paid budgets across parallel model attempts
goal: Make free-only, permitted paid fallback and hard spending limits explicit selection policies, using existing consent surfaces and asking only when a needed paid fallback lacks authorization. Reserve request/token allowance and estimated spend atomically across workers, fallback attempts and probes; reconcile actual usage, handle unknown prices and uncertain completion conservatively, and never bypass a budget via key rotation. Free quota exhaustion must not silently incur charges or trigger top-up. Wire reservations into actual dispatch. Hermetic concurrency tests cover shared-account keys, simultaneous free quota depletion, missing usage and retries. Implement tests named cloud_free_paid_budget_*; acceptance must execute at least one test.
